scenarios.prompt: Write TypeScript: the existing validators validateEmail(email), validatePassword(password) and validateAge(age) return Validate<string, T> with messages formatted as 'field: reason' (e.g. 'email: must contain @'). For a CreateAccount request (email, password, age), run all the validators and accumulate every error. The HTTP layer needs FieldError objects { field, message } instead of strings. Return { status: 201, body: account } when valid, or { status: 422, body: FieldError[] } listing every error.

output.result: a function (validators: { validateEmail, validatePassword, validateAge }) => (request: { email, password, age }) => { status, body }
